description: Clears sources.landscape.sourceUrl so src/components/MemberDirectory/DirectoryFreshness.js renders the plain-text 'cncf/landscape' arm of its link ternary at line 30 instead of the anchor at line 26. The arm needs the membership sentence to render -- sources.landscape.collectedAt parseable -- while the snapshot URL is absent, which is what a collector run that pins a snapshot it cannot address by URL leaves behind. It cannot go in the ordinary coverage build, whose anchor is the one tests/e2e/member-directory-freshness.spec.js asserts, nor in the variant build, which makes collectedAt unparseable and drops the sentence the arm lives in. It shares this build with the metrics overlay beside it because nothing else reads sources.landscape.sourceUrl and this build already renders the note, so it costs no additional compile.
